crime: {WITCH_NAME} used to stop among the library shelves without choosing a book. Her cellmate once chose one for her and read it aloud in the library. It became an evening habit: the cellmate chose and read while {WITCH_NAME} listened. {WITCH_NAME} was spared each choice and gained steady company; the cellmate gained an attentive audience and the authority to decide for both of them.

One evening, {WITCH_NAME} arrived with an ordinary book she had selected without help. Her cellmate took it, pressed a thick hardback of the cellmate's own choosing into her hands, and said that she still needed someone else to decide for her.

{WITCH_NAME} angled the dark screen of her phone toward her cellmate and watched the reflection. A girl browsing nearby looked over her shoulder and saw the reflected cellmate bend at the lounge fireplace and push the confiscated book into the fire. The real cellmate remained motionless in the library with the book in hand.

{WITCH_NAME} put away the phone and left first with the hardback. The cellmate left later with the confiscated book. The browsing girl saw the departure match the impossible reflection and followed without alerting either of them. At the lounge doorway, {WITCH_NAME} came out carrying the same closed hardback and passed the browsing girl.
Inside, the browsing girl found the cellmate dead beside the fireplace, with repeated blunt wounds to the back and side of the head. One edge of the confiscated book had burned in the fire.

The image of the book burning and the charred edge showed that the cellmate had privately decided to burn the book before giving any outward sign. Because {WITCH_NAME} had left first, she must have known where the cellmate would go instead of following afterward.

The hardback had been wiped clean outside, but the cellmate's blood remained under the edge of its cover and between the page edges at one corner. That corner matched the clustered head wounds. The browsing girl had seen {WITCH_NAME} receive the hardback from the cellmate and leave the library with it, then carry the same closed book out through the lounge doorway.

{WITCH_NAME} had sat by the fireplace with the hardback open and let her cellmate read her posture as submission. When the cellmate turned to put the confiscated book into the fire, {WITCH_NAME} closed the hardback and used one corner to strike the back and side of her cellmate's head repeatedly until the cellmate died.
fields.epitaph: The surest hand gave her nothing to read before it closed.
execution: An enormous mirror-polished iron hand lies open with her standing on its palm. Its raised fingers surround her. She watches their reflections for a preview of their next movement, but the metal shows only what she is doing now. The hand closes. Its fingers fold across her legs and torso and crush her rib cage against the palm. The grip tightens until her chest collapses and her breathing and heartbeat stop.

magic.name: Premonitory Reflection
magic.text: When she deliberately watches a living person's reflection, the reflecting surface shows the first physical action that person has begun to intend toward her before that person recognizes or expresses the intention.
